2.4.2.3-r1.burton_quote: that no Physic doth purge one humour alone, but all alike or what is next
2.4.2.3-r1.translation: They held that purging medicines convert whatever humour they touch into their own nature.

2.4.2.3-r2.burton_quote: drying medicines are to be repelled, as Aloe, Hiera, and all pills whatsoever

2.4.2.3-r3.burton_quote: against those that divulge and publish medicines in their mother tongue
